decisions.reason: Shuttering magnet blocks are a low-cost consumable in the firm's core precast formwork business, so they likely meet aspiration while demand for prefabricated building grows, though their absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 raises some doubt.

Magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line that fits the established range and is cheap to carry, so with slack from an expanding business there is little reason to start a search for other uses of the resources.
This single magnetic formwork component resembles Product F, which was already dropped, so it is more exposed to range consolidation, but it still complements the core offer at low cost.
